fields.description: What this replica serves, off its deployment. The gateway routes on it.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Only provisioned (Active) boxes are offered — a deploy onto anything else fails on the is_provisioned gate.
fields.label: Inference Server

fields.description: Auto-allocated (read-only): lowest free port from 8080 up, scoped to this Inference Server (→ --port / vllm_port). Multi-tenant box → one port per deployment; freed on teardown and reused. Box-local only — the engine proxy is what is reachable from outside.
fields.label: Engine Port

fields.description: Auto-derived (read-only): https://BOX-IP/e/SLUG — this deployment's location on its box's engine proxy, which forwards to its own vLLM instance. The gateway forwards straight here (no LiteLLM); vLLM serves /v1/messages natively.
fields.label: Engine URL

fields.description: Grove's own key between the gateway and this engine. Generated on the first Deploy and served with — read-only, because a hand-typed value would only ever disagree with the key that is on the box.
fields.label: Internal API Key

fields.description: Owned by the lifecycle buttons and the plays they run — not hand-set.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Provisioning
Active
Inactive
Terminated
Broken

fields.description: Per-box overrides of the deployment's tuning. Every field here is blank by default and inherits; a value set here wins for this replica only.
fields.label: Tuning Overrides

fields.description: → --kv-cache-dtype. fp8 halves the KV cache, buying context on a card short of VRAM. Prefilled with auto; CLEAR it to inherit the deployment's value instead. Set one only when THIS box needs it — a second owner for a field is drift, so keep the reason box-shaped.
fields.label: KV Cache Dtype

fields.description: → --gpu-memory-utilization (0-1). 0 inherits — the value is never legitimately zero, which is what lets one column carry both. Prefilled with 0.9; CLEAR it to inherit the deployment's value instead. Set one only when THIS box needs it — a second owner for a field is drift, so keep the reason box-shaped.
fields.label: GPU Memory Utilization

fields.description: → --max-num-batched-tokens. 0 inherits. Blank inherits the deployment's value. Set one only when THIS box needs it — a second owner for a field is drift, so keep the reason box-shaped.
fields.label: Max Num Batched Tokens

fields.description: → VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND. Prefilled with auto; CLEAR it to inherit the deployment's value instead. Set one only when THIS box needs it — a second owner for a field is drift, so keep the reason box-shaped.
fields.label: Attention Backend

fields.description: → --max-model-len. Takes a suffix — 32k, 128k, 1m — or a plain token count. Blank inherits the deployment's value. Set one only when THIS box needs it — a second owner for a field is drift, so keep the reason box-shaped.
fields.label: Max Model Len

fields.description: → --max-num-seqs, and the gateway's admission cap for THIS replica. 0 inherits, and the route table resolves it through the deployment — so the cap the gateway holds this engine to is always the number the engine is really running. Prefilled with 1024; CLEAR it to inherit the deployment's value instead. Set one only when THIS box needs it — a second owner for a field is drift, so keep the reason box-shaped.
fields.label: Max Num Seqs

fields.description: What this replica's container actually runs — the deployment's shape with this replica's overrides applied. Rebuilt on save.
fields.label: Serve Command

fields.description: How many lines from the end of the log to fetch. Capped at 5000.
fields.label: Lines

fields.description: Runs docker logs against this deployment's container on its box. Nothing is stored on this document.
fields.label: Fetch Engine Logs

fields.description: Follows this deployment's container log live (docker logs --follow over SSH). Streaming stops on its own after 30 minutes.
fields.label: Start Streaming

fields.description: The service this is a replica of. It owns the image, the shape and the tuning; this doc owns only where the replica sits. Set once — a replica of a different deployment is a different replica.
fields.label: Model Deployment

fields.description: Extra `vllm serve` flags for THIS replica, appended after the deployment's rather than replacing them — vLLM takes the last occurrence of a repeated flag, so this can add a flag or override one of the deployment's without retyping the rest. Blank adds nothing.
fields.label: Extra Serve Args
